newsitem.title: USA: Chattanooga, Tenn., adopts $131.6 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Chattanooga, Tenn., adopts $131.6 million budget.

text.p: Tennessee's Chattanooga City Council has approved a $131.6 million general fund budget, the Chattanooga Times said Wednesday.
The budget for the year that begins July 1 raises spending by 2.2 percent over this year and leaves property tax rates unchanged.

Most of the increase was allocated for stormwater and drainage improvements, school police officers and cleaning vacant lots. Funding for most city departments and programs was unchanged from this year.
